capabilities: Chat with Claude, Codex, OpenCode or local models
Search notes and PDF passages by keyword and on-device semantics
Assemble source-linked research records in Research Desk
Generate drafts, HTML artifacts, Canvas files and Bases
Review and accept or reject proposed note edits
extras: No telemetry; credentials are kept in Obsidian's encrypted secret storage rather than data.json. The optional MCP bridge binds to 127.0.0.1, needs a bearer token and keeps writes disabled until enabled; desktop shell execution is disabled on mobile. The repository also holds a separate obsidian-agent project of portable workflows that does not require this plugin.
motivation: The author wanted notes, sources and AI in the same workspace, keeping sources, drafts and decisions together in the vault.
problem: Notes, sources and AI chat sit in separate tools, so drafts drift from the evidence behind them and AI edits reach notes without review.

relations.evidence: choose a signed-in Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode CLI on desktop
Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for chat and utility work
sends search terms or bibliographic identifiers to OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, or Zotero

requires.name: Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode CLI

summary: AI workspace that connects Claude, Codex, OpenCode or local models to vault notes for source-linked research, drafting and reviewed edits.
